images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. First-person seat view inside a 1920s art-deco auction hall: deep crimson velvet drapes with gold fringe and tasselled tie-backs frame a gilded stepped proscenium. Center stage, a large backlit cream fabric screen hangs from a brass rod; behind it a single warm lamp projects a soft-edged black shadow of a standing crane statue on one leg with an S-curved neck and raised wing, a faint thin extra line beside its leg. At the right a silhouetted auctioneer in a top hat raises a gavel behind a mahogany podium, a gold speech card reads '2,400원 — 더 없습니까?'. Foreground: rim-lit silhouettes of bidders in bowler and cloche hats, one lifting a paddle numbered 11, small cream cue tags '헛기침 ×2' and '패들 0.4초'. The player's own ivory paddle '17' at bottom right. Left: a parchment observation notebook '관찰 수첩' with two shadow sketches. Bottom: brass lamp-angle dial '45°' and gold buttons '패들 올리기'. Title '그림자 경매' in gold deco lettering. Warm tungsten spotlights, dust motes, heavy vignette, film grain.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The same art-deco auction hall moments after the hammer falls: the cream screen has been torn down and rolled on its brass rod, a ragged strip still hanging. A hard white spotlight cone falls on a red velvet pedestal holding the real object: a crane statue painted to look like bronze, with white plaster showing through chipped spots and a thin steel support rod plainly visible beside its single leg, circled in red with a tag '쇠 지지대'. Large gold headline at top '낙찰 — 17번 2,900원'. On the right, a cream appraisal sheet '감정 결과서' with a ledger showing '−2,750원' and a round red ink stamp '위작'. On the left a dark deco panel shows remaining funds '200원'. In the foreground crowd one rim-lit man in a bowler hat holds paddle 3 and smirks, tag '3번 · 흐흠, 흐흠'; the player's paddle 17 droops at bottom right. Crimson, black and gold palette, chiaroscuro, bitter comic mood, film grain, vignette.
